description: Design tokens and global shell. Append the @theme block, two new keyframes (pulse-dot, marquee-sheen), their matching .animate-* utilities (gated by the existing prefers-reduced-motion media queries), and the new utility classes (.glass-nav incl. dark override, .editorial-headline, .eyebrow, .accent-bar-*) to src/app/globals.css. Create the OsmStatusContext (client-only Provider with useMemo'd value), StatusPill (single aria-live wrapper), SegmentedControl (role='radiogroup' with sliding pill geometry inset-1 + calc widths), MobileNavDrawer (createPortal with SSR mount guard, focus trap, Esc/scroll-lock, z-[60] backdrop + z-[70] sheet, drawer focus-trap selector comment per iteration-3 NIT #9), Header (sticky glass nav, pathname-driven right-cluster CTA, aria-label='Open navigation' hamburger), and Footer (server component, 4-column grid with OSM/Nominatim attribution and tech-stack badges). Wrap layout.tsx body with <OsmStatusProvider><Header /><main id="main">{children}</main><Footer /></OsmStatusProvider> while keeping layout.tsx a server component. Preserves every existing globals.css variable, keyframe, utility, and delay-* class. Chunk B and C will convert AreaPicker/Dashboard roots from <main> to <div>; a transient duplicate-<main> during this feature is acceptable since neither typecheck nor lint fails on it.
steps: In src/app/globals.css, after the `@import "tailwindcss";` line and before the existing `:root` block, add the Tailwind v4 `@theme { ... }` block exactly as specified in design.md section '1. Tailwind v4 @theme block' (surfaces, brand, --color-accent-red/amber/green, --color-status-ready/streaming/error, type scale, elevations). Do not touch the existing `:root` variables.

Append `@keyframes pulse-dot` and `@keyframes marquee-sheen` to the existing keyframes block in src/app/globals.css per design.md section '2. New keyframes and utilities'. Append `.animate-pulse-dot { animation: pulse-dot 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }` and `.animate-sheen { animation: marquee-sheen 2.4s linear infinite; }` INSIDE the existing `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` block. Add both class names to the comma-separated no-op list under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`.

Append the new utility classes to src/app/globals.css per design.md section '3. New utility classes': `.glass-nav` (plus a `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .glass-nav { ... } }` override), `.editorial-headline`, `.eyebrow`, and `.accent-bar-critical` / `.accent-bar-moderate` / `.accent-bar-lower`. Do not add `.focus-ring`, `.brand-badge`, `.animate-slide-in-right`, or a `slide-in-right` keyframe (iteration-2 NITs #4, #5, #6).

Create src/components/OsmStatusContext.tsx: `'use client';` module exporting `type OsmStatus = 'idle' | 'streaming' | 'ready' | 'error';`, `OsmStatusProvider({ children })` using `useState<OsmStatus>('idle')` + `useMemo(() => ({ status, set: setStatus }), [status])` (iteration-1 finding #5), and `useOsmStatus()` returning the context. Default context value `{ status: 'idle', set: () => {} }` so consumers outside the provider do not throw.

Create src/components/StatusPill.tsx: `'use client';`. Call `useOsmStatus()`. Render `<span role="status" aria-live="polite" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-white/80 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium">` with an inner `<span aria-hidden="true" />` dot colored by status and `motion-safe:animate-pulse-dot` when status is 'ready' or 'streaming'. Visible label strings: 'Live OpenStreetMap data' | 'Streaming OSM…' | 'Data unavailable' | 'Live OpenStreetMap'. No nested sr-only live region (iteration-2 NIT #8).

Create src/components/SegmentedControl.tsx: `'use client';` generic component with prop surface `{ options: readonly T[]; value: T; onChange: (next: T) => void; renderOption: (value: T) => React.ReactNode; ariaLabel: string; className?: string; }` where T extends `string | number`. Root `<div role="radiogroup" aria-label={ariaLabel} className="relative inline-grid auto-cols-fr grid-flow-col rounded-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-white/70 p-1 shadow-[var(--shadow-glass-sm)]">` (iteration-3 NIT #4 — radiogroup, not group). Inner sliding pill `<span aria-hidden="true" />` with className `absolute inset-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--green-dark)] motion-safe:transition-transform motion-safe:duration-200 motion-safe:ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none` and inline style `{ width: \`calc((100% - 0.5rem) / ${options.length})\`, transform: \`translateX(calc(${activeIndex} * ((100% - 0.5rem) / ${options.length})))\` }`. Each option button: `<button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={value === opt} data-active={value === opt} onClick={() => onChange(opt)} className="relative z-[1] min-h-11 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold aria-checked:text-white data-[active=true]:text-white focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--green)] focus-visible:ring-offset-2">{renderOption(opt)}</button>`. Keyboard: `onKeyDown` handles `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight` to cycle, `Home`/`End` to jump. `activeIndex = Math.max(0, options.indexOf(value))`.

Create src/components/MobileNavDrawer.tsx: `'use client';`. Props `{ open: boolean; onClose: () => void }`. Mount guard: `const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false); useEffect(() => setMounted(true), []); if (!mounted || !open) return null;`. Then `return createPortal(, document.body);`. DrawerBody renders backdrop `
` and sheet `
`. First child inside the sheet is `

GreenGap navigation

` (iteration-2 MEDIUM #2). Add a comment above the focus-trap `querySelectorAll('a, button, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])')`: `// Drawer contents are limited to ,

Create src/components/Header.tsx: `'use client';`. Root `
` with inner `
`. Brand `` containing a glyph badge `◒` and `

GreenGap

Urban greening priority

`. Desktop nav `
` with four Next.js `` elements for `/#overview`, `/#presets`, `/#methodology`, `/explore`. Active-route styling via `usePathname()`: on `/explore`, the Live Analysis link carries `aria-current="page"` and a `relative after:absolute after:inset-x-3 after:-bottom-0.5 after:h-0.5 after:bg-[var(--green)]` highlight. Right cluster: `` + a pathname-driven CTA — on `/explore` render `Change area`, otherwise `Jump to presets` (iteration-1 finding #6). Hamburger button `md:hidden min-h-11 min-w-11 aria-label="Open navigation" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls="mobile-nav"` toggling a local `useState(false)`. At end of header, render ` setOpen(false)} />`. All focusable chrome uses `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--green)] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[var(--background)]`.

Create src/components/Footer.tsx as a server component (no 'use client'). Root `<footer role="contentinfo" className="mt-10 border-t border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--panel)]">` with inner `<div className="mx-auto grid max-w-[1600px] gap-6 px-4 py-10 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">`. Four columns: (1) brand (`◒` + 'GreenGap') + mission sentence + a Next.js `<Link href="/#methodology">Methodology</Link>` ; (2) data attribution: 'OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)', 'Nominatim geocoding', 'Overpass API' as text lines; (3) scientific disclaimer paragraph verbatim from DESIGN.md § 3.F ('Scores reflect mapped features to guide site investigation, not civil engineering approval.'); (4) tech-stack badges rendered as `<span className="rounded-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-white/60 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px]">` for Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, Leaflet, Turf.js + an external GitHub repo link with `rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"` (use the repo URL from package.json metadata if present; otherwise placeholder '#' with a TODO comment). Bottom bar `<div className="bg-[var(--green-dark)] text-white/80">` with '© GreenGap · built on open data' and three /# anchor links.

Edit src/app/layout.tsx to import `Header`, `Footer`, `OsmStatusProvider` and change the body JSX to `<body className={...}><OsmStatusProvider><Header /><main id="main">{children}</main><Footer /></OsmStatusProvider></body>`. Keep `metadata`, the Geist font setup, the `leaflet/dist/leaflet.css` import, and the server-component status (no 'use client' at this level) unchanged.
